⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Stray tool artifact committed**

`.dmtools-target-workingdir` is a 1-byte local tool marker (its only content is `.`) that got committed to the branch by the `gh-18 WIP auto-save 2026-11-02T11-05-54` commit.

- It does **not** exist on `main` (checked `git ls-tree origin/main`), unlike the `.fah/trajectories/**` files, which are an established pattern in this repo from previous merged PRs.
- It is not covered by `.gitignore`, so it will sit at the repo root forever and every future session may re-commit variants of it.

Please remove it from this PR:

```bash
git rm --cached .dmtools-target-workingdir
```

and consider adding it to `.gitignore` so the auto-save flow stops picking it up.

Non-blocking for functionality — analyze/tests are green — but it is unrelated to the gh-18 ticket scope and pollutes the tree.

💡 **SUGGESTION: Third copy of the `_waitForImage` golden helper**

This PR copy-pastes the 15-line `_waitForImage` helper into `test/home_page_golden_test.dart` — it is byte-for-byte identical to the copies in `test/collection_page_golden_test.dart:13` and `test/collection_item_details_page_golden_test.dart:13`. This is now the third duplicate in the suite.

Consider extracting it once, e.g. `test/golden_test_helpers.dart`:

```dart
/// Waits until [provider] delivers a decoded image (see golden tests).
Future<void> waitForImage(ImageProvider provider) { ... }
```

and importing it from all three golden tests. Keeping the doc comment about the real-event-loop image codec in one place also prevents the copies from drifting. Optional polish — the copy itself is correct and mirrors the existing pattern.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: No retry affordance on the failure state**

`NewsLoadFailure` renders only a static "Failed to load news" message. Because the feed loads once via `NewsStarted` from `BlocProvider.create`, a user who hits a transient failure has no way to retry except restarting the app:

```dart
NewsLoadFailure() => const _HomeError(), // dead end — bloc supports re-dispatch
```

`NewsBloc` already registers `on<NewsStarted>(...)`, so a retry is a one-liner away — give `_HomeError` an optional callback and wire a button:

```dart
NewsLoadFailure() => _HomeError(
  onRetry: () => context.read<NewsBloc>().add(const NewsStarted()),
),
```

Note: `_CollectionError` in `CollectionPage` has the same gap, so this is pre-existing app-wide behavior, not a regression introduced here — fine to defer to a shared follow-up ticket covering both pages.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: Hardcoded English month names**

`NewsCard._formatDate` renders dates with a private English month table:

```dart
String _formatDate(DateTime date) =>
    '${date.day} ${_monthNames[date.month - 1]} ${date.year}';
```

The PR description documents the "no `intl`" decision, and since the entire app hardcodes English strings (`'Home'`, `'Failed to load news'`, …) this is consistent today. Just flagging for the future: if/when localization arrives, `DateFormat.yMMMd(locale)` (or a shared formatter util) should replace this, because a per-widget month table is exactly the kind of string that silently stays English in a localized app. No change requested now.

## Automated Code Review — APPROVE (with suggestions)

**Summary**: gh-18 implemented correctly — `HomePage` news feed follows the established `CollectionPage`/`CatCard` architecture (repository + bloc + sealed states, barrel exports, `NewsCard` mirroring `CatCard`), adds 13 meaningful tests (repository, bloc, page, golden), no new dependencies. Verified in this run: `flutter analyze` → no issues; `flutter test` → **46 passed** (matches the PR description). No blocking findings; ticket AC "implement home screen with a fake news feed with images" is fully satisfied.

**Key Issues**:
- ⚠️ **IMPORTANT** — `.dmtools-target-workingdir` (1-byte tool artifact) was committed by a WIP auto-save; it is not on `main` and not gitignored. Remove it from the branch.
- 💡 4 suggestions — barrel export order, third copy of the `_waitForImage` golden helper, no retry affordance on the failure state, hardcoded English month names.

**Next Steps**:
1. Remove `.dmtools-target-workingdir` from the commit (and consider gitignoring it) — everything else is mergeable as is.
2. Optionally apply the suggestion-level polish items in a follow-up.
